segments.source: Add biquadratic filter audio-effect processing to apps like Logic Pro X and GarageBand with the Accelerate framework.

segments.source: Overview
segments.ko: Overview

segments.source: An audio unit extension provides a way to create or modify audio and MIDI data in an iOS or macOS app that uses sound — including music-production apps.
segments.ko: An audio unit extension provides a way to create or modify audio and MIDI data in an iOS or macOS app that uses sound — including music-production apps.

segments.source: It contains the audio unit and, optionally, a user interface to control the audio unit.
segments.ko: It contains the audio unit and, optionally, a user interface to control the audio unit.

segments.source: The audio unit is a custom plug-in where you generate audio or implement an audio-processing algorithm.
segments.ko: The audio unit is a custom plug-in where you generate audio or implement an audio-processing algorithm.

segments.source: You can shape the output of an audio signal, such as by boosting or cutting the bass or treble of a music track, with the single-channel and multichannel biquadratic filters that the vDSP library provides.
segments.ko: You can shape the output of an audio signal, such as by boosting or cutting the bass or treble of a music track, with the single-channel and multichannel biquadratic filters that the vDSP library provides.

segments.source: This sample code project is a peaking EQ filter implemented with a vDSP biquadratic filter that’s delivered as an audio unit extension.
segments.ko: [`videoZoomChanged`](avcapturedevice/primaryconstituentdevicerestrictedswitchingbehaviorconditions-swift.struct/videozoomchanged.md)가 제한된 전환 동작 조건에 포함되지 않은 경우에도 [`AVCaptureDevice.PrimaryConstituentDeviceSwitchingBehavior.restricted`](avcapturedevice/primaryconstituentdeviceswitchingbehavior-swift.enum/restricted.md)는 비디오 줌 팩터 변경으로 카메라가 [`activePrimaryConstituent`](avcapturedevice/activeprimaryconstituent.md)로 선택되거나 선택 대상에서 제외되는 경우 카메라 선택을 허용합니다.

segments.source: You can use the code in this project as the basis for writing audio units that use the [`vDSP`](vdsp.md) library.
segments.ko: You can use the code in this project as the basis for writing audio units that use the [`vDSP`](vdsp.md) library.

segments.source: This project is based on the Audio Unit Extension App Xcode template and uses the *Effect* audio unit type.
segments.ko: 비디오 줌 팩터가 활성 primary constituent device의 전환 임계 줌 팩터보다 낮아지면 시스템은 요청된 줌 팩터를 충족하기 위해 다른 카메라를 선택합니다.

segments.source: This type of audio unit accepts an audio input and produces an audio output.
segments.ko: This type of audio unit accepts an audio input and produces an audio output.

segments.source: The template provides an audio pass-through effect with a signal parameter to adjust the gain of the audio that passes through the audio unit.
segments.ko: The template provides an audio pass-through effect with a signal parameter to adjust the gain of the audio that passes through the audio unit.

segments.source: For more information about creating audio unit extensions, see [`Creating an audio unit extension`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AVFAudio/creating-an-audio-unit-extension).

segments.source: The peaking EQ filter requires three parameters: the center frequency, the Q value (which controls the shape of the response curve), and the decibel gain.
segments.ko: The peaking EQ filter requires three parameters: the center frequency, the Q value (which controls the shape of the response curve), and the decibel gain.

segments.source: To allow the host app to interact with the parameters, the sample code project describes their default value, value range, name, and identifier in `Parameters.swift`.
segments.ko: To allow the host app to interact with the parameters, the sample code project describes their default value, value range, name, and identifier in `Parameters.swift`.

segments.source: The identifier value you specify is what the audio unit uses to reference the parameter from the host app.
segments.ko: The identifier value you specify is what the audio unit uses to reference the parameter from the host app.

segments.source:
```swift
ParameterSpec(
    address: .frequency,
    identifier: "frequency",
    name: "Frequency",
    units: .hertz,
    valueRange: 20 ... 20_000,
    defaultValue: 100.0
)

ParameterSpec(
    address: .Q,
    identifier: "Q",
    name: "Q",
    units: .generic,
    valueRange: 0.1 ... 25,
    defaultValue: 1
)

ParameterSpec(
    address: .dbGain,
    identifier: "dbGain",
    name: "Decibel Gain",
    units: .linearGain,
    valueRange: -50 ... 50,
    defaultValue: 15
)
```
